candidates.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
candidates.reason: Long-context decode scheduling on commodity GPUs; directly studies page-aware work assignment and adaptive scheduling rather than only attention kernels.
evidence: Native paged decode attention with adaptive scheduling against FlashInfer
Held-out traces report 1.063–1.265x throughput on B8 workloads and 1.399x on a B1 bucketed trace
